constraints: Returns Null if no footer is found for the given parameter(s).

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Returns the footer of the first page in the range or the section/sub-section passed as targetObj (returns the visible footer if a sub-section is active).
Returns the footer of the section identified by sectionIndex (>=1) in wpDoc, or of a specific sub-section type of that section when sectionSubType is passed.
